title: Parsing commands with patterns
description:
Turn typed commands into actions with nullable types and pattern matching.

```
> move 3 -2
Moved to (3, -2)
> move 1
move needs two numbers
> say hello world
You say: hello world
> undo
Back at (0, 0)
> undo
Nothing to undo
```
hints: `case ["move", var xs, var ys] when int.TryParse(xs, out int x) && int.TryParse(ys, out int y):` matches and converts in one case (lesson 2.05).
Add `case ["move", ..]:` after it to catch the wrong number of arguments.
requirements: `Parse(string line)` returns a `Command?`: `null` when the line is empty.
Use a `switch` with list patterns on the words: `["move", var x, var y]`, `["say", .. var rest]`, `["undo"]`.
Keep the positions in a `Stack<(int X, int Y)>` for undo.
stretch: Add `redo`, with a second stack that is cleared by every new move.
